title: Von Braun shows Uri Geller a piece of a crashed UFO
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Von Braun shows Uri Geller a piece of a crashed UFO, about an unknown time at NASA secret base, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Wernher von Braun shows Uri Geller a piece of a crashed UFO
as_told.place_text: Wernher von Braun's office, United States

plain: Uri Geller, a man famous for claiming mind powers, says the rocket engineer Wernher von Braun, who worked for NASA, the US space agency, took him into his personal office, opened a safe, and pulled out a light piece of metal in a color Geller had never seen. Geller says he touched it and said it was not from here, and von Braun replied that it was a piece of a UFO that had crashed on our planet. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, also repeats the story, naming the astronaut Edgar Mitchell as part of the chain and placing it at a secret NASA base rather than von Braun's office; if true, it would mean a top space scientist held crash material from another world.
